rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)

problems.what: the hook is a dark, empty board with one small amber word rattling in its top row and garbage in the clock; nothing lands, nothing says 'this is a board and it is about to change'
problems.fix: a power-on sweep: every cell flips one colour flap to amber on the first frames, then a diagonal wave flips them back while DEPARTURES spells itself in amber

problems.what: 0 abrupt changes in 24 s: every act is the same uniform rattle, 1.5-2 s of drum travel per change (DELAYED to BOOKED is 38 flaps as aligned); the two hits (00:08.5, 00:19.0) have no visual punch because colour arrives cell by cell
problems.fix: faster flaps (2 frames), status words aligned for the shortest drum trips, rows and the status column landing every cell on the same frame on the hits, camera cuts to a tight status framing for the trouble and the booking, a kick on each hit

problems.what: the end is three seconds of the whole board clearing through random glyphs; the sign-off rows land at 23.3 and 23.6 s, so the clean end card holds for under half a second (the 23 s phone frame is still rattling in both sizes)
problems.fix: every cell of the board lands on the sign-off cue together (a clean snap), about 2.5 s before the end, then a real hold with the printed lines

problems.what: the printed ticker is 34 px: about 6 px wide text on a phone in landscape
problems.fix: 46 px, shown only in wide shots

problems.what: row 6's ON TIME is readable for about 18 frames before it rattles to DELAYED
problems.fix: board the day faster so row 6 settles well before its DELAYED starts; verify the gap from the runs

problems.what: the status spans colour their blank padding cells, which read as a dash at phone size: '-DELAYED', '-BOOKED-'
the 3% push-in snaps back to 1.00 on each act cut: a small pop, not a cut
problems.fix: make framing changes deliberate cuts (wide to tight), or none

agentSaw: variety: 0 abrupt changes per 10 s and one 24 s calm; the long, uniform drum travel
the first 2 s are a mostly blank board with amber DEPARTURES rattling
row 6's ON TIME shows only about 18 frames in landscape
the printed ticker (34 px) is small on a phone
the push-in resets on the cuts at 120, 960, 1200
agentMissed: the end act: about 3 s of full-board glyph noise and under half a second of clean end card
the hits land with no visual punch because each cell takes its colour at its own frame
the cause of the long travel: the status words are aligned so DELAYED to BOOKED needs 38 flaps on one cell
coloured blank padding flaps read as dashes ('-DELAYED', '-BOOKED-') at phone size

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)
fixed: hook: every flap on the board flips to amber at once on frame 0 (one colour flap each), a diagonal wave flips it back from 0.4 s while DEPARTURES spells itself in amber and the clock rattles in; DEPARTURES no longer has to clear, row 0 turns straight into the first meeting

drum travel: a flap now takes 2 frames (30 flaps a second, a full trip 1.3 s), with the phase sampled mid-frame so both frames of a flap show the flip in motion; forward-only drum and two-half flips unchanged

punches: each DELAYED row snaps red on its beat (00:09.0-00:10.5) and the whole status column snaps green on one hit (00:17.5): every cell starts at its own frame and lands within 6 frames of the hit, with a small fixed jitter so cells bound for the same letter never show the same flap in unison

camera: deliberate cuts on the beat to a close-up on the times and meetings (00:05-00:07), on the status column (00:08-00:11, 00:16-00:18), and wide again; a decaying kick on every hit; a wide shot runs across act boundaries so the push never snaps back (the reset is hidden inside the sign-off snap)

end: the whole board snaps clean on the sign-off (00:21.5) to ORIEL in amber; the promise row rattles into EVERYONE BOOKED letter by letter, the web address rattles in on the message row, and the printed line lands at 23.3 s; about 2.5 s of clean end card instead of under 0.5 s
ticker at 46 px (weight 500), shown only in wide shots; the second ticker became the message row flipping to NEW TIMES FOUND, which also fills the calm before the booking
row 6's ON TIME now reads for about 1.5 s before its DELAYED rattle starts (the day boards every 54 frames)
status colour only on letter flaps: no more '-DELAYED' / '-BOOKED-' dash reads

problems.what: the status close-up crops the meeting names mid-word at its left edge ('UP', 'N CRIT', 'ITH ANA'); the crop falls between whole cells, so it reads as a camera crop, not a bug
critique.mjs finds no abrupt change between the power-on flash and the trouble cut: the vertical's names close-up (z 1.35) is too close to the wide framing to register, though rows board every 0.9 s
problems.fix: none needed; the pace is carried by the rows

problems.what: at the end of the 5-second wide shot the 5% push carries the right-hand lamps about 10 px past the safe margin
problems.fix: a slower push if it matters; the still-frames gate needs some push

problems.what: the web address is a flap row now (the brief asked for it printed in mono); its dot is 38 flaps round the drum and lands last, so the full address reads for about 0.5 s (vertical) to 0.8 s (landscape)
problems.fix: accepted: the rattle keeps the end alive for the still-frames gate and the flap address is larger than the 26 px print was

rounds.note: re-read before shipping: two of the round-2 8s leaned on 'accepted' problems (the web address readable for under a second; the wide push carrying the lamps past the safe margin by about 20 px, not 10), so round 2 is a fix, not a ship

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)
fixed: safe area: the wide push pivots about the point that brings the board's sides (lamps included), the clock and the printed lines to the safe margins together (about 4% of room in both sizes), and a long wide shot pushes more slowly (3.8% at most), so nothing leaves the safe area
landscape cuts in on the TIME column while the new times land (00:13-00:15); the four new-time snaps and their kicks now read large, and critique.mjs counts 4.2 changes per 10 s (was 3.3)
the names close-up moved to 00:04 (beat 8), so the first wide shot is 4 s and its push stays small

the web address is whole by 00:23.0 in both sizes (the dot's cell sets off at 21.7 s and lands at 22.9 s; the last letter lands at 23.0 s): about 1 s of the full address, with the ORIEL / promise rows and the printed line on screen from 21.5 s and 23.0 s
the power-on wave starts at 0.5 s and the first row sets off at 1.8 s, so the amber board and DEPARTURES each hold under half a second of stillness
measured from the runs: row 6's ON TIME reads for about 1.5 s in landscape (lands 7.9 s, DELAYED rattle starts 9.3 s) and 1.8 s in vertical

problems.what: the status close-up crops meeting names mid-word at its left edge ('UP', 'N CRIT'); the edge falls in the gap between two cells, so it reads as a camera crop

critique.mjs finds no abrupt change between the power-on flash and the trouble cut (the vertical names close-up is 1.35x, too close to the wide to register as a cut), though a row boards every 0.9 s and the close-up is visible
problems.fix: none needed; the pace is carried by the rows

problems.what: the web address is a flap row, not the brief's mono print, because a printed line gave the end nothing to move and the still-frames gate failed
problems.fix: accepted as a deliberate change to the brief; the flap address is about twice the size of the old 26 px print
